recentItems.title: Thousands protest Barcelona airport expansion plan
recentItems.description:
Thousands of Barcelona residents marched to protest against a 500 metre expansion of Barcelona’s main airport.

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

Protesters argued the plans would harm two protected natural areas, increase greenhouse gas emissions and fuel further growth in tourism that they consider unsustainable.

recentItems.title: Germany election results #Germany #Afd #DieLinke
recentItems.description:
Polls have closed in two state elections in Germany, with initial exit polls showing heavy losses for Friedrich Merz's CDU party in both.

The German chancellor was quick to take responsibility, describing the results as a "disaster", but vowing to stay on as chancellor.

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

The mounting pressure had already prompted Merz to cancel his trip to the UN General Assembly in New York next week.

recentItems.title: Sheeran apologises in first show since Macklemore controversy
recentItems.description:
Ed Sheeran has apologised on stage in his first show since the Macklemore Palestine controversy.

The pop star was emotional as he addressed the backlash over the decision to drop the rapper Macklemore from his tour, at his first concert since the controversy broke. 

He told fans in Philadelphia that he'd made mistakes.

recentItems.title: Ukraine launches over 1,000 drones in 'unprecedented' attack on Russia capital
recentItems.description:
Ukraine launched over 1,000 drones towards Russia and said it put a key oil refinery out of action in what Moscow's mayor called the biggest drone attack yet on the city and surrounding region. 

Officials said three people were killed. 

Meanwhile, Russia kept up its attacks on Ukraine, with eight people killed and dozens more injured and Kyiv has come under further attack from drones.

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

It didn't stop the final day of Russia's elections going ahead, though the only anti-war party had been banned from standing.

Reporter: Jonathan Rugman

recentItems.title: Greenlanders 'don't trust Donald Trump' #Greenland #DonaldTrump
recentItems.description:
Greenlandic politician Tillie Martinussen says people on the island "don't trust Donald Trump" after he announced a security deal for Greenland between the US and Denmark.

Martinussen said she trusts the Danish and Greenlandic leaders though, and believes the agreement reached between the countries might be very similar to the original treaty signed in the 1950s.

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

Trump said the agreement meant the US would maintain a "large military presence" in Greenland, possibly ending his threats to annex the island. The Danish and Greenlandic prime ministers welcomed the deal and said it would be signed next week.

recentItems.title: Ed Sheeran addresses tour controversy #EdSheeran
recentItems.description:
Ed Sheeran apologised for "mistakes" and addressed his feelings about the Israel-Palestine conflict at his first concert since the controversy over Macklemore being dropped from his tour and other support acts quitting.

Sheeran said the attacks in Israel on 7 October were "horrific" and what is happening in Gaza is "catastrophic". He said "injustice" in the West Bank also "cannot be overlooked".

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

Before the concert in Philadelphia, a protest took place outside the venue where some fans said they could no longer support Sheeran while others hoped politics could stay apart from the music.

Macklemore was forced to leave Sheeran's tour after venue owners threatened to ban him over pro-Palestinian comments on stage, with other acts leaving the tour as well in solidarity.
